state.assertions: Mandatory examples attach to every function, yet a consumer-held owner value has no row-level construction path: the foreign type resists direct building, and its throwing constructor cannot appear in an input expression for want of failure handling there. A consumer-private helper with no domain errors can bridge the gap and fault on unexpected refusal, at the price of extra declarations and assertion rows. The LD29 outcome deliberately added no new assertion syntax.
state.failure_observation: Failed completions at the HTTP edge collapse to an invariant 500 while emitting no diagnostic by default. Manual capture plus safe logging is available per handler, and database faults carry usable codes, so coverage today hinges on author discipline at every site. Redacting reporters with occurrence tracking already serve program entry, late ownership, and browser callbacks; only the request edge lacks its default.
state.host_boundary: A distribution-controlled catalogue owns every host operation, leaving ordinary dependencies no route to fresh JavaScript or npm capability. Browser callbacks observe four snapshot fields, attribute writes never reach dirty live values, and storage, navigation history, plus browser sockets are missing. Connections demand literal origins with path confinement. Bounded subprocesses, declared literal clients, and service HTTP already escape the server side, narrowing the true gap to in-process browser features.
state.iteration: Synchronous tail relay grows the native stack: the same emitted countdown succeeds at one hundred iterations and overflows near twenty thousand under Bun 1.4.2. That observation grants no general tail-call guarantee claim. Folds already walk materialized arrays safely. Ongoing pagination and state machines await an intentional design that preserves ordering, error identity, fixture paths, and diagnostic value, with thresholds treated as environment-specific.
state.library_errors: Value-level generic reuse ships, while failure abstraction lags: authored bounds enumerate fixed nominal errors and a type variable in emits position is rejected. Built-in array combinators propagate caller-specific bounds that user code cannot declare. Concrete per-use bounds or data-wrapped outcomes work around the gap. The prize is a single helper reused across two foreign error domains with neither widening nor silent translation.
state.lifetime: Selection and settlement diverge: winners publish promptly, owners retain losers through drainage, and the measured probe keeps roots open until late branches finish, which delays HTTP answers past slow losers. Query and transaction paths await drivers without caller budgets; busy timeouts govern lock queues alone and session timeouts lack a Can spelling. Server fetch enjoys deadlines while browser action transport exposes none. Signal shutdown awaits settlement without a wait bound, so supervisors own the final escalation and unknown writes stay honest.
state.objective: Assess Can for everyday SaaS products across server and browser targets. The project carries no users and no backwards-compatibility burden. Non-negotiables are immutable domain values, spelled failure contracts, and owned resources. Generated TypeScript must reuse native JavaScript and Bun behavior, adding adapters solely to uphold Can guarantees. No code changes follow from this consultation.
state.progress: Revision 2cb1bc3 delivers request-aware shared actions mounted from one locked package, capability-audited browser bundles paired with server builds, declaration-checked public generics, and uncertainty-honest transactions. Treat those as the floor: proposals must compose with them, and none may quietly redefine them.
state.ui: Real grid code in Can covers versioned drafts, conflict handling, stale-reply protection, disposal, and rendering, though each field repeats handler glue and whole-view rebuilds plus focus fixes. First-class functions with records and callables already permit library factoring. Native input truth comes before any abstraction choice, and component syntax remains guilty until proven necessary.
